description: Source code implementing ELF relocations handling, including initialization, application, and symbol resolution for dynamic linking in an ELF loader.

classes.name: Relocations
classes.description: Handles ELF relocation processing, including initialization, applying relocations, and symbol resolution.

methods.name: Relocations::Relocations
methods.description: Constructor initializing relocation context with base address, dynamic section, and exported symbols.

methods.name: Relocations::HasTextRelocations
methods.description: Returns whether text relocations are present.

methods.name: Relocations::InitRelocations
methods.description: Initializes relocation entries based on dynamic section data.

methods.name: Relocations::ApplyAllRelocations
methods.description: Applies all relocations, including regular and PLT relocations.

methods.name: Relocations::ApplyRelocation
methods.description: Applies a single relocation, resolving symbols if necessary.

methods.name: Relocations::ApplyResolvedReloc
methods.description: Applies a resolved relocation based on its type (architecture-specific).

methods.name: Relocations::GetRelocationType
methods.description: Returns the relocation type enumeration based on ELF relocation type.

methods.name: Relocations::ResolveSymbol
methods.description: Resolves a symbol's address from dynamic section or exported symbols, handling weak symbols.
